protocol.name: downstream-effects-v1
protocol.readout_numerics: Each vocabulary readout uses fixed [1,1,hidden] input shape, independent of requested position count
protocol.groups: prior top32, prior bottom32, three uniform random32 groups
protocol.matching: Pair top/random calibration full-output effect RMS at their minimum using gains in (0,1]; no holdout fitting
protocol.intervention: Exactly one token in one FFN per forward; attenuate selected gate outputs before native outgoing projection; weights unchanged
protocol.primary_metrics: KL(reference||edited) and signed observed-next-token NLL change at edited and future token; full vocabulary
protocol.aggregation: Mean within each passage across its two distinct single-site experiments, then mean across 12 passages
protocol.fidelity: Unchanged upstream blocks, causal prefix and nonedited source positions must be bitwise equal; local delta error <= 1e-4*predicted_delta_L2 + 2e-6*reference_MLP_L2 + 1e-8
protocol.limits: Reused diagnostic holdout, not fresh blind data or a language benchmark; zero ablation is a counterfactual that may leave the activation distribution; no feature semantics or mediated path attribution inferred
